booking.title: Appointments
booking.off: Booking online is not turned on at this hospital yet.
booking.cancelBody: The time becomes free again. Nobody is contacted.
booking.cancelConflict: This appointment cannot be cancelled any more: it was already cancelled or it has started.
booking.openBody: These are the open times the hospital lets patients book.
booking.needClinic: Enter the hospital code above to see open times.
booking.noSlots: There are no open times right now.
booking.alreadyBooked: This appointment was already booked for you.
booking.bookRefused: This time cannot be booked by this account. Nothing was booked.
booking.bookConflict: This time is no longer open, or you have reached the hospital's limit of future appointments. Nothing was booked.

messages.title: Messages to the hospital
messages.off: Messages are not turned on at this hospital yet.
messages.confirmBody: This sends your message to the hospital. It is stored encrypted.
messages.refused: This cannot be done for this account: it must be active and linked to a record at that hospital. Nothing was sent.
messages.invalid: The message was not accepted. It may be empty or too long. Nothing was sent.
